name: Camping 101: First Aid

angles.text: Cooking instructors teach you to build a basic campfire. You need one before setting up a wilderness campsite or adding medical amenities.
Nurse Neela teaches in Brill, the Forsaken town in Tirisfal Glades, giving Horde travelers a local source of instruction.
As an Undead, you can turn to Nurse Neela in Brill for help adapting your medicinal skills to survival in Lordaeron's ruined lands.

faq.answer: Nurse Neela practices medicine in Brill, the Forsaken town in Tirisfal Glades. She teaches skilled First Aid practitioners to make kits for wilderness camps.

aliases: what is a first aid kit
faq.answer: A First Aid Kit is a camp accessory made by First Aid practitioners. At a wilderness campsite, it supplies what travelers need to treat injuries.
faq.q: What does a First Aid Kit do at a camp?

faq.answer: A campfire must be in place before you can set up other camp amenities, including medical kits. Cooking instructors and cooks teach you to build a basic campfire.
faq.q: Why do you need a campfire to set up camp?

faq.answer: You need to camp in the open wilderness. Town residents and local authorities generally object to tents and fires in the middle of town streets.
faq.q: Can you set up a camp inside a town?

faq.answer: Nurse Neela in Brill teaches eligible travelers to make a First Aid Kit once they have enough First Aid skill.
faq.q: Who teaches how to make the First Aid Kit?

faq.answer: Nurse Neela in Brill teaches you to use your field medicine skills to prepare medical supplies for outdoor camps.
faq.q: What is the goal of Camping 101: First Aid?

sections.body: Beyond guarded settlements, beasts and rival factions put travelers in danger. A healer trained in First Aid can learn to assemble a First Aid Kit for a wilderness camp. With it, travelers can tend wounds far from settled lands.
sections.title: Medicine in the Field

sections.body: In Brill, Nurse Neela teaches travelers to put their medical skill to work at camp. Those skilled in bandaging and treatment can learn to make a portable First Aid Kit. First, travelers need a wilderness site and a basic campfire. Cooking instructors can teach them how to build one.
sections.title: Instruction in Brill

summary: At wilderness camps, Camping 101: First Aid helps healers prepare for injuries. In Brill, Nurse Neela teaches skilled practitioners to make a First Aid Kit for treating wounds far from settled lands.
